findings.title: OpenCode Security Breach Exposes Third-Party API Keys of its Console Users
findings.summary_md: OpenCode disclosed a security breach affecting 1.4% of its Console users, warning that third-party provider API keys saved in affected workspaces may have been exposed. The intrusion targeted a legacy system the company was already decommissioning. The vendor statement is dated October 17, 2026.

findings.title: OpenCode Console breach exposed users' AI provider API keys
findings.summary_md: OpenCode disclosed on 17 October 2026 that an unauthorized party reached a legacy Console system it was retiring. The affected group is 1.4% of Console users, all with an outside provider linked, and the company told them via email to revoke keys with each provider and replace them.
